The top 100 novels of all time published in English, as voted for by authors, critics and academics worldwide. How many have you read?
As voted for by authors, critics and journalists Sat 16 May 2026 06.00 BST First published on Tue 12 May 2026 14.00 BST

The greatest literature ever published in English, as voted for by

longer on the list. See also corrections and clarifications .
